leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Whose…? Possessive ’s
leadIn.content: Whose jacket is this? It is Sarah's jacket. Whose shoes are those? They are the boys' shoes.

form.title: Form & Structure: Whose…? Possessive ’s
form.content: Whose + noun...? Answer: Name/Noun + 's for singular owners (Sarah's bag); Noun + ' for plural owners ending in s (the parents' car).

controlledPractice.question: 'This is ___ car.' (owner: Mike)
controlledPractice.explanation: Add 's after the singular owner's name: Mike's car.

controlledPractice.question: Owner is plural and already ends in -s: 'my ___ house' (parents)
controlledPractice.explanation: When the plural owner already ends in -s, just add an apostrophe: parents'.

controlledPractice.question: Question word for ownership?
controlledPractice.explanation: Whose asks specifically about ownership: Whose bag is this?
